title: [Main] Generate Lines from Allocation Account Line leaves incorrect Non-deductible VAT amounts when Prices Including VAT is enabled.
summary: Fixed a bug where generating lines from allocation account lines produced incorrect non-deductible VAT amounts when prices including VAT was enabled.
key_points: Non-deductible VAT amounts are now correct when lines are generated from an allocation account line with Prices Including VAT enabled
Fix made in codeunit Purchase Alloc. Acc. Mgt. in the W1 and ES layers
End-to-end tests added for the W1, IT, NL and NO layers
quote: Generate Lines from Allocation Account Line leaves incorrect Non-deductible VAT amounts when Prices Including VAT is enabled.
